data.description: Balancing Bridge is a long, low crossing of round stepping pads in blue and orange, hung between steel end frames. A hand rope runs above the pads, and a short ladder at the end helps children get on. As they cross, the pads move under their feet, so they learn to shift their weight, hold the rope and steady themselves. At 24'2" x 2'11" it is long and narrow, which makes it a good link between two parts of a playground or a run along a boundary. The safe play area is 29'2" x 7'11". Colours are Play Orange and Knight Blue. A 3-year warranty covers its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Share your site plan and we will place it on a layout drawing.

props.pText: The pads are linked and suspended, so the links holding them take most of the wear. Inspect them and the hand rope at every service, and tighten the end-frame fixings. The frames are grouted or installed self-standing. Keep the 29'2" x 7'11" zone clear and lay rubber flooring under the full length of the bridge.
